value.title: Implementation guide — Copilot native extension delivery

sections.name: architecture
sections.value:
Binding doctrine: .agents-skills-port/pij-team/TENETS.md (repo-local copy); repo AGENTS.md; Plan109 graded findings (historical RPC mechanics superseded, consent/order/receipt lessons applicable). PM authors all plan/guide changes. Three coders with disjoint fences own daemon, native extension, and installation/proof harness. PM freezes wire and file-layout contracts before fan-out; same-file mutation prohibited.

Frozen architecture:
1. User extension source .copilot/extensions/pij/extension.mjs; split runtime-neutral state/helpers into adjacent store.mjs only when it removes test/runtime coupling. SDK import is top-level @github/copilot-sdk/extension and resolved by Copilot, never a new npm dependency. No giant inline bundle or fs polling bridge. Use daemon blocking inbox wait as in PoC, abortable and reconnectable.
2. Add optional registration capability native_extension_delivery:boolean (default false) and persisted SeatDescriptor representation; only verified live Copilot extension registration asserts true. PID+proc_start is runtime truth, not extension child PID guessed as host; require parent context supplied by native runtime or a verified ancestor. Preserve harness_session and exact pane. Same-incarnation reconnect preserves correct capability; new incarnation/revive clears it until attested. Registration response changes additive. Any claimed native-session mismatch refuses rather than hijacks an existing seat.
3. Copilot becomes extension-only: arrival queues, pointer/drain excludes Copilot; pre-attach/new unsupported seat remains pending or explicit unavailable. A true capability permits native claim; false cannot claim as supported native delivery. No path types/pastes a Copilot message/control command, even on transient extension failure. Existing OMP/Pi behavior unchanged. Never hide pane metadata to force paneless route. Historical RPC migration scripts untouched; remove runtime rpc_port_intent/allocator/flags and obsolete Copilot-only paths, using forward migration if removing persisted column.
4. Human input consent lives in existing InteractionGate. Native Copilot claims with panes require the current fresh permission verdict at handoff; held claims stay durable and wake when permission changes or on bounded retry cadence. No policy/timing edits in crates/core/src/delivery.rs or crates/harnesses/src/interaction.rs (plan136 owns); expose/use existing API, request PM decision if insufficient. Pi/OMP exemption unchanged. Failed sensor must not count as permission.
5. Native receive lifecycle: one consumer/session, one claim at a time, capture Pij msg_id + native returned messageId; durable acceptance record before ack; repeated Pij delivery consults that record and native event/history evidence rather than blind reinjection. Ack after native acceptance, not after mere file read, never label model completion. Native idle/assistant evidence is separate. Abort loop and close handles on extension/session change. Reconnect refreshes bearer key; non-JSON HTTP failures keep status/body diagnostic. Avoid persistently replaying malformed or unsupported commands. Ambiguous crash boundary produces honest failure/held diagnostic unless current native events prove acceptance; no universal exactly-once claim.
6. Outgoing API: native tool pij_send({to:string,message:string}) calls authenticated Pij /v1/send with immutable registered seat as from and newly minted msg_id; returns receipt with acceptance grade. Do not install an automatic assistant-response forwarding loop. Regular Pij CLI in pane must resolve current seat; for paneless users native tool is supported outgoing path. Do not change global process identity or mutate parent environment. Existing identity projections may gain additive native-session metadata only.
7. Installation extends guarded harness/scripts/link-global.ts + just link/install/doctor conventions. Canonical checkout owns global artifact; COPILOT_HOME overrides default ~/.copilot; expected destination extensions/pij/extension.mjs and any adjacent module links. Preserve foreign symlinks/real files; merge experimental:true into settings.json without deleting unknowns; do not copy PoC hooks/provider settings. Disabled extension mode remains explicit opt-out with actionable diagnostic, not coerced session mutation. Isolated homes supported for tests and real witnesses without touching developer's real settings.
8. Body messaging scope: do not add a native remote-control RPC. Copilot programmatic compact/new/reload requests explicitly refuse at producer/caller boundary with no legacy/tmux fallback. Other harness controls unchanged. Native user-driven new/resume/reload remains lifecycle input; no forced /clear workaround.

Scope exclusions: current plan136 vocabulary/interaction implementations and the .pi/extensions/pij extension-side hold queue, unrelated gates, installed binaries, machine global configuration, governance ledger, other stream code. Shared crates/daemon/src/delivery/mod.rs extension-stream match is notified at implementation and takes baton at COMPOSITION only. Plan135 additive register response; do not revert its contracts at convergence.
PM ACK rulings (2026-09-05): claim/ack native consumer proof includes native_session,pid,proc_start for Copilot; daemon validates at handoff/ack and verifies ack recipient before mutation. Native new session explicitly supersedes same-process prior identity; unsolicited mismatch refuses. Existing OMP/Pi wire calls unchanged. Manual smoke permits endpoint/state isolation env, forbids Pij identity/preallocation env and RPC launch flags. Named .pi caller guards are narrow daemon fence exceptions; hold queues remain forbidden.
Further ACK rulings: assets/inputs/pm-ack-rulings.md. Runtime acceptance records private under state-dir/native-extensions/copilot keyed by stable seat/native session (not PID/start); unresolved states not evicted. Malformed/unsupported claim explicitly stops receive with actionable diagnostic/no ack, no new deadletter API; outgoing tool stays available. Installer never reads private record layout as its proof oracle.
PM scope ruling2026-09-05: Queue lacks a by-ID running delivery read, so authorize claimed_delivery(job_id)->Result<Option<Job>> on existing Queue port plus real store/FakeQueue/delegating test wrappers. Derive recipient from job before applying Copilot-native tuple/seat validation; other harness semantics unchanged. No bulk queue scan. Plan136 PM pij-fellow-whale reports prime ruling:136 no longer edits delivery/mod.rs;137 owns extension match exclusively, prior baton requirement superseded. Still exclude136 delivery vocabulary/interaction/hold queue.
Opus preflight adjudicated in assets/inputs/pm-opus-preflight-rulings.md, contractv3. Shared service admission closes shim side doors; native claim proof echo mandatory; consent-held wait returns empty promptly plus diagnostic and bounded client retry. Absent daemon/key must not disrupt ordinary Copilot startup. No sensor skip for precomposition missing native tests. Two reviewer interpretations refuted: consent is a brake; initial queued reply receipt does not negate subsequent paneless round-trip native/ack evidence.
Diagnostic interface: stable `[pij native] unavailable:` line through native session log/terminal, once per failure episode; no secrets. Unit tests count sink invocations, real smoke captures terminal prefix+ordinary nonce. Native log-dir is supplemental, not a promised private-layout dependency.
Lifecycle clarifications: assets/inputs/pm-lifecycle-rulings.md. Internal queued target binds native session, not old PID; true same-session revive consumes with fresh current PID proof, different native context holds old work. Pre-join no-session diagnostic may use once-only stderr/native loader; post-join outages use native session.log.
PM runtime source finding: serial claim/send/ack alone is not the retained Plan109 observed-completion barrier. After fresh send, wait for generation-matched native idle/error before NEXT claim; ack remains acceptance-grade. Capture early idle, stop and duplicate-recovery without a silent hang. Runtime owner correcting with targeted test.
Code-review adjudication supersedes earlier journal key wording: private acceptance journal keys stable seatID+native session; PID/start is active-consumer validation and optional in-record diagnostic, never directory identity. See pm-code-review-rulings.md. Known non-Copilot controls preserved; unverified targets fail closed explicitly. Default installation treats absent optional Copilot as advisory; standalone doctor remains strict. Expensive native observations must not monopolize fleet-wide claim/ack exclusion.

value.rationale: Jordan requested parallel capacity and clean boundaries. Exactly three independent Astra1m/high coders in disjoint worktrees: Rust daemon, native JS extension, installer+proof harness. Contract fixtures frozen by PM before any dispatch; no fourth coder can get an independent useful slice without fragmenting lifecycle or duplicating integration.

value.name: Daemon native-delivery ownership
value.paths: crates/core/src/model.rs; crates/core/src/ports.rs only if concrete persisted capability requires; crates/store/src/**; NEW forward migrations; crates/daemon/src/registration.rs; crates/daemon/src/delivery/**; crates/daemon/src/pointer/**; crates/daemon/src/http/**; crates/daemon/src/lib.rs; crates/harnesses/src/spawn.rs; crates/cli/src/** Copilot-specific cleanup only; corresponding Rust tests. EXCLUDE core/src/delivery.rs, harnesses/src/interaction.rs, all .pi files EXCEPT the explicitly named Copilot control guards below, Cargo.lock, installer/JS extension.; .pi/extensions/pij/cli.ts and core/generation-routing.ts Copilot-only unsupported control/fallback guard plus direct tests (NOT hold queues); crates/testkit/src/fakes.rs Queue forwarding; affected delegating Queue test wrappers only (including sidecars tests if compile requires)
value.responsibility: Add verified native-extension capability and exclusive Copilot inbox ownership; preserve other harnesses; safe claim consent admission; remove RPC intent runtime and spawn machinery; explicit unsupported Copilot remote-control refusal without legacy fallback (no new control protocol).
value.interface: assets/contracts/native-extension.json. Additive register native_extension_delivery bool default false with verified copilot process/session binding. True copied in descriptor response; no other response rename. All Copilot messages queue to native delivery; unattached cannot claim as attached; pointer/drain never types Copilot. Claim/ack/send current envelopes unchanged. Existing fresh InteractionGate API for pane-backed claim; no 136 policy edits. Expose stable diagnostic on disabled/unavailable native consumer. Contractv2: Copilot native GET claim and POST ack carry native_session/pid/proc_start; validate against current attested descriptor on handoff, and ack job recipient before mutation. Other-harness requests retain compatibility. New native session supersedes prior same-process seat explicitly, reconnect same native retains seat. PM authorized Queue::claimed_delivery(job_id) -> Result<Option<Job>>: inspect only a currently-running delivery job without mutation; derive real recipient BEFORE native-specific validation/ack. Real store/FakeQueue/delegating test implementations required, no unrelated port behavior changes. v3: native guard shared service-level across direct and shim routes; native_consumer proof echo in Copilot claim; consent-held wait returns[] promptly, never waits for unrelated outcome. Match+gate one unit.
value.test_strategy: Existing Rust crate tests, real SQLite + fixture-based request parity. Assert no first-send nor drain tmux submit; hold/admit positive pair; matching/mismatching pid/session; no native capability reuse across replacement; duplicate/ack semantics; historical migration upgrade; unchanged Pi/OMP/Claude behavior. Do not run project-wide gates while siblings edit; all targets local to this worktree.
value.note: Shared delivery/mod.rs match composes under prime baton; no global daemon restart or toolchain upgrade.

value.name: Copilot native runtime bridge
value.responsibility: Join current native session and register true identity/capability; native outgoing pij_send tool; serialized blocking inbox consumer, durable acceptance before ack, reconnect/abort/session rollover and honest errors/events. No automatic reply forwarding.
value.interface: assets/contracts/native-extension.json and exact published file layout. SDK bundled top-level import @github/copilot-sdk/extension. Resolve PIJ_RS_ADDR, PIJ_RS_STATE_DIR/default ~/.pij-rs; use actual host process identity. Incoming message data includes msg_id/from/to/body and optional command; ACK contains seat and job_id. Outgoing tool {to,message} -> /v1/send immutable self. Capability readback before receive; preserve additive fields. Contractv2: send native_session/pid/proc_start on each claim and ack; immutable per-session tuple from confirmed registration. User-driven new native ID creates explicit checked superseding identity; reconnect same native ID preserves seat. Manual smoke endpoint-only env overrides allowed. v3: require matching native_consumer claim proof before send/ack; consent-held empty result bounded retry. Daemon/key absent must not break ordinary Copilot, no diagnostic spam.
value.test_strategy: node:test through proposed just copilot-native-test (installer owner provides recipe). Inject runtime/HTTP/storage for deterministic lifecycle/crash/duplicate and capability protocol tests; no new dependencies. Receiver consumes daemon-owned consent decision, never implements competing typing policy. Test buffered user/assistant events do not create auto-reply loop.
value.depends_on: PM contract frozen; runtime integration only after daemon branch composed
value.note: Use absolute worktree paths. Pure module stays free of SDK imports. Live host proof runs after composition; cannot claim production on standalone fake tests.

value.name: Managed installation and proof harness
value.paths: harness/scripts/link-global.ts and related link tests; new harness/scripts/copilot-native-* fixtures/doctor/smoke; justfile; README.md; docs/how/copilot-native-extension.md. May update vitest.config.ts only to include extension .test.mjs if essential; prefer node:test recipe. No Rust or .copilot extension-source edits.; .harness/extensions/checks/extension.ts + instructions.md for native-extension sensor only
value.responsibility: Idempotent canonical-home user extension installation/experimental settings merge/doctor; pave JS test and isolated actual manual+spawned CLI smoke commands. Preserve foreign paths and unknown settings. Capture exact native/daemon evidence, no global process disturbance.
value.interface: Consumes .copilot/extensions/pij/{extension,store}.mjs (never creates shipping stub). Add just copilot-native-test for node --test .copilot/extensions/pij/*.test.mjs; just copilot-native-smoke *ARGS runs harness/scripts/copilot-native-smoke.ts with --mode manual|spawned|both and --provider local|real, isolated config roots/dedicated tmux server and daemon. --provider local is explicitly deterministic fixture; --provider real requires actual model/provider and returns named prerequisite error if unavailable. Existing just link/install/doctor include Copilot managed state and honor COPILOT_HOME. Pave just copilot-native-rust-test as cargo test -p pij-core -p pij-store -p pij-harnesses -p pij-daemon -p pij-cli; add copilot-native-test to harness checks/self-check so native JS tests are not invisible. Do not change existing gate failure policy.
value.test_strategy: Extend existing link-global tests for empty/existing/foreign/malformed homes, idempotency, alternate COPILOT_HOME and settings preservation. Smoke driver must identify native messages by unique nonce and daemon IDs, check no duplicate, absence and typing hold as positive outcomes; gather process/version/build identity. In own tree test fixture protocol; real integrated smoke after PM merges shipping artifacts. Add daemon-absent ordinary Copilot startup witness and consent release WITHOUT another message. No missing-test skip; integrated sensor legitimately awaits composition.
value.depends_on: PM file/wire contract frozen; integrated real smoke depends on other branches
value.note: No actual global link/config changes from worktree. Only isolated homes; no npm/Cargo dependency mutation. Source artifacts may be absent before composition; fixture tests must not create shipping placeholders.

PM plan worktree /Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/fs3-copilot-native-extension branch137-copilot-native-extension. Coder child worktree off committed PM plan, named before dispatch. Absolute paths for every read/edit; worktree-local Cargo target. Main node_modules symlink read-only reuse, no dependency mutation. Reviewer reads coder/composed tree and writes only assets/reviews; no concurrent product mutation during review.

value.steps: PM commits validated plan+guide+contracts. Three coder worktrees branch off that commit; verify native runtime via canary then deliver exact per-unit packet and rule numbered ack. Each unit scoped proofs, no project-wide concurrent checks. Compact completed peer first; inspect patches/receipts. Merge daemon then extension then installer branches into PM plan branch, resolving no internal changes silently. Coordinate shared delivery/mod.rs match with136 at convergence, registration response additive to135. Run composed unit and integration proofs plus full harness checks; Opus independently reviews. Return upheld findings to original coder. PM alone owns plan/guide and evidence states. No main merge/public push/global install without authorization.
value.integration_proof: assets/evidence/manual-native, spawned-native, consent-positive-and-held, duplicate, missing-consumer, reconnect and real-model-canary receipts with process/version/commit identities. Terminal screenshots/capture and daemon/native event IDs, not only code assertions. Manual witness MUST be hand-started through dedicated tmux, not disguised pij spawn.

value.when: Validate PM-authored plan before coder dispatch; code review after implementation and before any rollout
value.inputs: plan.dd.md + impl-guide.dd.md + full code diff from committed plan base + exact evidence. Least confidence: parent/native identity and rollover, pane-based consent claim handoff/wake, crash native acceptance before ack, install settings preservation. DISBELIEVE receipts and re-derive relevant scenarios. Known-open: baseline file-watch-notify smoke red and npm git-dep min-release-age/before conflict; do not relabel as implementation defects or skip final reporting. Old-session compatibility explicitly exempt.
value.model_override: OMP github-copilot/claude-opus-5 high reviewer; three OMP github-copilot/gpt-6-astra-1m high coders. Do not update OMP or its local Astra patches.

value.text: Native child and host PIDs differ. Bind only verified actual host incarnation/session, and never steal another pane/seat.
Generic drain may race extension. Assert both initial and scheduled paths never submit tmux for Copilot and run pane-backed proof.
Native accepted before daemon ack is ambiguous under crash. Durable local acceptance plus native event/history evidence; never promise universal exactly-once without proof.
RPC/native transport can start a turn while human composing. Reuse current InteractionGate; no vocabulary/timing edits owned by136.
Global edits are risky. Use isolated homes for tests; canonical-main ownership and preservation checks; no real rollout in worktree.
Before code: typecheck passed, file-watch-notify smoke failed. Final deliverable must disclose full gate red if still present; no suppression.
